person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and third-person, with omniscient or shifting focal access to numerous characters. The Goodreads evidence includes unmistakable external narration of Patroni and, once its clipped context is restored by the authorized excerpt, Mel. Generic “you” in aphorisms and q01545 is not sustained second-person narration, while first-person forms occur only in speech. A complete authorized adaptation, an authorized opening excerpt, and explicit whole-book POV descriptions all agree on third person; no evidence indicates a sustained first- or second-person base section. The main limitation is that the strongest continuous web text is an authorized adaptation rather than the unabridged 1968 edition, but it agrees with the original Goodreads passages and the independent structural descriptions.
